title.en: Emotional reactions during arguments and social interactions
title.tr: Tartışmalarda ve sosyal ilişkilerde duygusal tepkiler
title.de: Gefühlsreaktionen im Streit und im Umgang mit anderen
title.fr: Réactions dans les disputes et les relations
title.it: Reazioni nelle discussioni e nei rapporti

expressions.expr: have a go at / go off on

meaning.en: to attack someone verbally; to shout at them
meaning.de: jemanden mit Worten angreifen; jemanden anschreien

equivalent.de: jemanden anmachen, jemanden zusammenstauchen, auf jemanden losgehen

variety.en: have a go at sb: BrE (in AmE "have a go at sth" = to try) · go off on sb: AmE
variety.tr: have a go at sb: BrE (AmE'de "have a go at sth" = denemek) · go off on sb: AmE

usage.en: have a go at sb (for V-ing / about sth) · go off on sb (for/about sth)
usage.tr: have a go at sb (for V-ing / about sth) · go off on sb (for/about sth)

sentences.en: My boss [had a go at] me for being five minutes late.
sentences.tr: Beş dakika geciktim diye patronum bana fırça attı.
sentences.de: Mein Chef hat mich zusammengestaucht, weil ich fünf Minuten zu spät war.

sentences.en: She [went off on] him in front of the whole class.
sentences.tr: Bütün sınıfın önünde ona verip veriştirdi.
sentences.de: Sie ist vor der ganzen Klasse auf ihn losgegangen.

meaning.en: to make an unrelated person suffer for your own stress or anger
meaning.tr: kendi stresinin/öfkesinin acısını ilgisiz birinden çıkarmak
meaning.de: den eigenen Stress oder Ärger an jemandem auslassen, der nichts dafür kann

literal.en: to take it (what's inside) out and put it on someone
literal.tr: onu (içindekini) dışarı çıkarıp birinin üstüne koymak

usage.en: take sth (it / your anger / your stress) out on sb. Two particles: out (letting it out) + on (the target).
usage.tr: take sth (it / your anger / your stress) out on sb. İki parçacık: out (dışa vurma) + on (hedef).

sentences.en: I know you've had a bad day, but don't [take it out on] me.
sentences.tr: Kötü bir gün geçirdiğini biliyorum ama acısını benden çıkarma.
sentences.de: Ich weiß, du hattest einen schlechten Tag, aber lass es nicht an mir aus.

sentences.en: He [takes his stress out on] his family.
sentences.tr: Stresinin acısını ailesinden çıkarıyor.
sentences.de: Er lässt seinen Stress an seiner Familie aus.

meaning.en: to suddenly attack someone verbally (often because you are hurt)
meaning.tr: (çoğu zaman incindiği için) birine aniden sözle saldırmak
meaning.de: jemanden plötzlich mit Worten angreifen (oft, weil man verletzt ist)

equivalent.de: um sich schlagen, jemanden anfahren, ausfallend werden

usage.en: lash out (at sb) — intransitive. The cause is usually pain, fear or helplessness; that is the difference from blow up.
usage.tr: lash out (at sb) — geçişsiz. Sebep çoğunlukla acı, korku ya da çaresizliktir; blow up'tan farkı budur.

sentences.en: She [lashes out at] people when she's hurt.
sentences.tr: Kırıldığında insanlara saldırıyor.
sentences.de: Sie fährt Leute an, wenn sie verletzt ist.

sentences.en: I'm sorry I [lashed out] — I was scared.
sentences.tr: Sert çıktığım için özür dilerim, korkmuştum.
sentences.de: Tut mir leid, dass ich so ausfallend geworden bin – ich hatte Angst.

meaning.en: to keep your feelings inside; to suppress them
meaning.de: seine Gefühle für sich behalten; sie unterdrücken

equivalent.de: etwas in sich hineinfressen, Gefühle unterdrücken

literal.en: to put into a bottle and close the lid; up = completely, tightly
literal.tr: şişeye doldurup kapağını kapatmak; up = tamamen, sıkıca

usage.en: bottle sth up / bottle up sth (transitive, separable; with a pronoun: bottle it up) · keep sth bottled up
usage.tr: bottle sth up / bottle up sth (geçişli, ayrılabilir; zamirle: bottle it up) · keep sth bottled up

sentences.en: Don't [bottle it up] — talk to someone.
sentences.tr: İçine atma, biriyle konuş.
sentences.de: Friss es nicht in dich hinein – rede mit jemandem.

sentences.en: He [bottles up] his feelings and then explodes over something small.
sentences.tr: Duygularını içine atıyor, sonra ufacık bir şeyde patlıyor.
sentences.de: Er frisst seine Gefühle in sich hinein und explodiert dann wegen einer Kleinigkeit.

meaning.en: to tell someone your feelings and private things
meaning.de: jemandem seine Gefühle und Privates erzählen

equivalent.de: sich jemandem öffnen, aus sich herausgehen

usage.en: open up (to sb) (about sth) — intransitive. The opposite of bottle up.
usage.tr: open up (to sb) (about sth) — geçişsiz. bottle up'ın karşıtı.

sentences.en: It took him months to [open up to] me about his family.
sentences.tr: Ailesi hakkında bana açılması aylar sürdü.
sentences.de: Es hat Monate gedauert, bis er sich mir gegenüber über seine Familie geöffnet hat.

sentences.en: She doesn't [open up] easily.
sentences.tr: Kolay kolay içini açmaz.
sentences.de: Sie öffnet sich nicht so leicht.

expressions.expr: vent / let off steam / blow off steam

meaning.en: to release anger or stress by talking or by physical activity
meaning.tr: içindeki öfkeyi/stresi anlatarak ya da hareket ederek boşaltmak
meaning.de: Ärger oder Stress durch Reden oder Bewegung abbauen

equivalent.tr: içini dökmek, dert yanmak; deşarj olmak, stres atmak
equivalent.de: sich Luft machen, sich auskotzen; Dampf ablassen

literal.en: vent = an air outlet; steam (ANGER IS A HOT FLUID IN A PRESSURISED CONTAINER)
literal.tr: vent = havalandırma deliği; steam = buhar (ÖFKE = BASINÇLI KAPTAKİ SICAK SIVI)

variety.en: vent: AmE + BrE · let off steam: BrE · blow off steam: AmE
variety.tr: vent: AmE + BrE · let off steam: BrE · blow off steam: AmE

usage.en: vent (to sb) (about sth) · "I just need to vent." (I want a listener, not a solution) · let/blow off (some) steam
usage.tr: vent (to sb) (about sth) · "I just need to vent." (çözüm değil dinleyici istiyorum) · let/blow off (some) steam

sentences.en: Sorry, I don't need advice — I just need to [vent].
sentences.tr: Kusura bakma, tavsiye istemiyorum, sadece içimi dökmem lazım.
sentences.de: Entschuldige, ich brauche keinen Rat – ich muss mich nur mal auskotzen.

sentences.en: I went for a run to [blow off some steam].
sentences.tr: Biraz deşarj olmak için koşuya çıktım.
sentences.de: Ich bin laufen gegangen, um Dampf abzulassen.

meaning.en: to argue with someone and stop being friendly
meaning.de: sich mit jemandem streiten und nicht mehr befreundet sein

equivalent.de: sich mit jemandem zerstreiten, sich überwerfen

literal.en: to fall out (of line / of the relationship)

variety.en: the verb is mainly BrE · AmE uses the noun: have a falling-out (with sb)
variety.tr: fiil hâli ağırlıklı BrE · AmE'de isim: have a falling-out (with sb)

sentences.en: I [fell out with] my best friend over something really stupid.
sentences.tr: En yakın arkadaşımla çok saçma bir şey yüzünden bozuştuk.
sentences.de: Ich habe mich mit meiner besten Freundin wegen etwas wirklich Dummem zerstritten.

sentences.en: They had a [falling-out] years ago and haven't spoken since.
sentences.tr: Yıllar önce araları bozuldu, o gün bugündür konuşmuyorlar.
sentences.de: Sie haben sich vor Jahren zerstritten und seitdem nicht mehr miteinander geredet.

meaning.en: to become friends again after a quarrel
meaning.de: sich nach einem Streit wieder vertragen

usage.en: make up (with sb) · kiss and make up · make it up to sb = to compensate someone for your mistake · make up for sth = to compensate. Don't confuse with: make sth up = to invent.
usage.tr: make up (with sb) · kiss and make up · make it up to sb = birine karşı hatasını telafi etmek · make up for sth = telafi etmek. Karıştırma: make sth up = uydurmak.

sentences.en: We argue a lot, but we always [make up] by the end of the day.
sentences.tr: Çok tartışırız ama gün bitmeden mutlaka barışırız.
sentences.de: Wir streiten viel, aber am Ende des Tages vertragen wir uns immer wieder.

sentences.en: I'm sorry I missed your birthday — let me [make it up to you].
sentences.tr: Doğum gününü kaçırdığım için özür dilerim, telafi edeyim.
sentences.de: Tut mir leid, dass ich deinen Geburtstag verpasst habe – ich mache es wieder gut.

expressions.expr: hold a grudge / hold it against

meaning.en: to stay resentful towards someone; to count something from the past against them
meaning.tr: birine kin gütmek; geçmişteki bir şeyi birinin aleyhine saymak
meaning.de: jemandem gegenüber nachtragend bleiben; jemandem etwas aus der Vergangenheit anlasten

equivalent.tr: kin tutmak, içinde tutmak; hâlâ aleyhine saymak
equivalent.de: nachtragend sein, einen Groll hegen; jemandem etwas nachtragen

literal.en: grudge = lasting resentment; hold = keep, not let go

usage.en: hold/bear a grudge (against sb) · hold sth against sb · "I won't hold it against you."
usage.tr: hold/bear a grudge (against sb) · hold sth against sb · "I won't hold it against you."

sentences.en: I'm not the kind of person who [holds a grudge].
sentences.tr: Kin tutan biri değilim.
sentences.de: Ich bin kein nachtragender Mensch.

sentences.en: I made one mistake two years ago and she still [holds it against me].
sentences.tr: İki yıl önce bir hata yaptım, hâlâ bana onu hatırlatıyor.
sentences.de: Ich habe vor zwei Jahren einen Fehler gemacht, und sie trägt ihn mir immer noch nach.

meaning.en: to perceive a general remark or behaviour as an attack on you
meaning.tr: genel bir söz/davranışı kendine yönelik saldırı gibi algılamak
meaning.de: eine allgemeine Bemerkung oder ein Verhalten als Angriff auf sich selbst auffassen

usage.en: take sth personally · "Don't take it personally." · "It's nothing personal." · take offence (BrE) / offense (AmE) = to be offended
usage.tr: take sth personally · "Don't take it personally." · "It's nothing personal." · take offence (BrE) / offense (AmE) = alınmak

sentences.en: Don't [take it personally] — he's like that with everyone.
sentences.tr: Üstüne alınma, o herkese böyle.
sentences.de: Nimm es nicht persönlich – er ist zu allen so.

sentences.en: I know it's just feedback, but it's hard not to [take it personally].
sentences.tr: Sadece geri bildirim olduğunu biliyorum ama kişisel algılamamak zor.
sentences.de: Ich weiß, es ist nur Feedback, aber es fällt schwer, es nicht persönlich zu nehmen.

meaning.en: to immediately start defending yourself when you sense criticism
meaning.de: sofort anfangen, sich zu verteidigen, sobald man Kritik spürt

equivalent.de: in die Defensive gehen, sich sofort verteidigen

sentences.en: Every time I bring it up, he [gets defensive].
sentences.tr: Konuyu ne zaman açsam hemen savunmaya geçiyor.
sentences.de: Jedes Mal, wenn ich es anspreche, geht er in die Defensive.

sentences.en: I'm not attacking you — there's no need to [get so defensive].
sentences.tr: Sana saldırmıyorum, bu kadar savunmaya geçmene gerek yok.
sentences.de: Ich greife dich nicht an – du musst dich nicht gleich so verteidigen.

meaning.en: to react more strongly than the situation deserves
meaning.tr: bir şeye olması gerekenden büyük tepki vermek
meaning.de: stärker reagieren, als die Situation es verdient

usage.en: overreact (to sth) · "You're overreacting." (may anger the other person further) · blow sth out of proportion = to make too much of something
usage.tr: overreact (to sth) · "You're overreacting." (karşı tarafı daha da kızdırabilir) · blow sth out of proportion = olayı gereksiz büyütmek

sentences.en: Okay, maybe I [overreacted] a little.
sentences.tr: Tamam, belki biraz abarttım.
sentences.de: Okay, vielleicht habe ich ein bisschen überreagiert.

sentences.en: I think you're [overreacting] — it was just a joke.
sentences.tr: Bence abartıyorsun, sadece şakaydı.
sentences.de: Ich finde, du übertreibst – es war nur ein Witz.

meaning.en: to stop pressuring someone; to stay out of it
meaning.de: aufhören, jemanden unter Druck zu setzen; sich heraushalten

equivalent.de: Lass mich in Ruhe! Halt dich da raus!; sich zurückhalten

usage.en: back off (intransitive). Compare: back down = to give in, withdraw a claim · back sb up = to support someone.
usage.tr: back off (geçişsiz). Karşılaştır: back down = geri adım atmak, iddiasından vazgeçmek · back sb up = birine arka çıkmak.

sentences.en: [Back off]! This has nothing to do with you.
sentences.tr: Karışma! Bunun seninle hiçbir ilgisi yok.
sentences.de: Halt dich da raus! Das geht dich nichts an.

sentences.en: I told my mom to [back off] and let me make my own decisions.
sentences.tr: Anneme üstüme gelmemesini ve kararlarımı kendim vermeme izin vermesini söyledim.
sentences.de: Ich habe meiner Mutter gesagt, sie soll sich zurückhalten und mich selbst entscheiden lassen.

meaning.en: to deliberately not speak to someone in order to punish them
meaning.de: absichtlich nicht mit jemandem sprechen, um ihn zu bestrafen

equivalent.tr: küsmek, surat asıp konuşmamak, trip atmak
equivalent.de: jemanden mit Schweigen strafen, jemanden anschweigen

usage.en: give sb the silent treatment · get the silent treatment (the one on the receiving end) · related: sulk = to be silently bad-tempered
usage.tr: give sb the silent treatment · get the silent treatment (maruz kalan) · ilgili: sulk = surat asmak

sentences.en: She's been [giving me the silent treatment] since Saturday.
sentences.tr: Cumartesiden beri benimle konuşmuyor.
sentences.de: Sie straft mich seit Samstag mit Schweigen.

sentences.en: Instead of [giving me the silent treatment], just tell me what's wrong.
sentences.tr: Küsüp susacağına derdin ne, söyle.
sentences.de: Statt mich anzuschweigen, sag mir einfach, was los ist.

equivalent.tr: hışımla çıkıp gitmek, kapıyı çarpıp çıkmak

usage.en: storm out (of a place) → out of an enclosed place · storm off → away from where you are
usage.tr: storm out (of a place) → kapalı bir yerden dışarı · storm off → bulunduğu noktadan uzağa

sentences.en: He [stormed out] of the room and slammed the door.
sentences.tr: Odadan hışımla çıkıp kapıyı çarptı.
sentences.de: Er ist aus dem Zimmer gestürmt und hat die Tür zugeknallt.

sentences.en: She [stormed off] before I could explain.
sentences.tr: Ben açıklayamadan öfkeyle çekip gitti.
sentences.de: Sie ist davongestürmt, bevor ich es erklären konnte.
